At lunch, if Bea is present, I ask what she enjoys about having the cinema open again. If she is not here, I eat with whoever is around.
I let the conversation finish and go back to the catalogue. I work until the end of my agreed shift.
The following morning I check with Nell for my next archive assignment and any practical changes I need to know about.
I say I am not available for additional front-of-house shifts; I want to keep the hours outside my archive contract for myself.
If Owen is around during a break, I ask how his week is going. If he is not, I take my break without looking for him.
If we have been talking, I tell Owen I will see him tomorrow. Then I take a walk along the harbour on my own.
